articles.headline: Sources: UEFA prepares criminal complaint against FIFA's Infantino over World Cup sell-off
articles.description: UEFA is preparing a criminal complaint against FIFA president Gianni Infantino in Swiss courts for possible financial mismanagement over his failed plan to sell future World Cup profits to private investors.

articles.headline: Saudi federation backs Gianni Infantino as FIFA president 'at this time'
articles.description: One month into a crisis for FIFA provoked by his failed World Cup sell-off plan, Gianni Infantino finally got some public backing from a key nation Thursday -- 2034 World Cup host Saudi Arabia.

articles.headline: Socceroos transfer tracker: Where Australia's stars will play in 2026-27
articles.description: There's nothing like a World Cup to put young stars in the shop window! With that in mind, ESPN has assembled a list of all the Socceroos' post-tournament transfers, all in one place.

articles.headline: Barcelona cancel World Cup tribute for Spain players
articles.description: Barcelona have canceled the planned tribute honoring its World Cup-winning players, which was set to take place during Thursday's opening home match.

articles.headline: Chelsea's Lucy Bronze: Need to 'protect' football for fans
articles.description: Lucy Bronze has said she wants to "protect [football] for the fans" after joining a collective statement criticising Gianni Infantino and the "current leadership's ability to distinguish between its own interests and what is best for football."
